blocks.html: Buildings whose main use or dominant occupancy is Group I-2 hospital and that are located in a flood hazard area shall be provided with connections for temporary external boilers and chillers in accordance with Section G304.5.2 by January 1, 2033, and a report detailing compliance with such requirements shall be filed with the department in accordance with Section G312.3.2 by such date.
